title: Paradox mod metadata (.metadata/metadata.json)
description: Descriptor of the newer Paradox convention (Victoria 3, EU5). The field set is the one three real workshop mods use; the schema stays permissive on purpose: unknown keys are allowed so a game-specific field never turns into a false error. The point is completion and typo surfacing, not validation.

name.description: Display name in the launcher and on the Workshop.

id.description: Stable identifier other mods point their relationships at. NOT the Workshop number.

version.description: Your mod's own version, not the game's.

supported_game_version.description: Game version the mod is for, e.g. "1.9.*". Use "*" when unknown.

game_id.description: Which game the mod is for. Written by some launchers, optional: mods load without it.

short_description.description: One-line summary shown in the launcher.

relationships.description: Links to other mods: dependencies, load order, incompatibilities.

id.description: The other mod's `id` field (NOT its Workshop number).

rel_type.description: How this mod relates to the other one.

resource_type.description: What the relationship points at. Only "mod" is supported by the launcher today.

display_name.description: Shown when the other mod is not on disk.

version.description: Version of the other mod, "*" for any.

game_custom_data.description: Per-game extras the launcher passes through.

multiplayer_synchronized.description: False marks the mod as checksum-irrelevant (cosmetic only).

replace_paths.description: Vanilla folders the mod unloads wholesale. Total conversions only.
